old_caption: The video captures a person performing push-ups on a tiled floor. The individual is dressed in a white shirt and dark shorts, positioned in front of a window with bars, allowing sunlight to stream through. The tiles beneath them are a mix of red and green hues, creating a patterned surface. To the left, there's a white door with a glass panel, and above it, a small shelf holds a few items, including what appears to be a can. On the right side of the frame, a metal railing is visible, suggesting the setting might be an outdoor or semi-outdoor area, possibly a balcony or patio. The person maintains a steady rhythm, moving their body up and down in a controlled manner, demonstrating a consistent exercise routine. The lighting from the window creates a bright spot in the upper center of the frame, adding a dynamic element to the scene. The overall atmosphere is calm and focused, emphasizing the physical activity taking place.

caption: The video captures a person wearing a white short-sleeved shirt in a push-up posture on a glossy red-and-green mosaic tiled floor. Strong sunlight from a barred window behind creates a bright lens flare that washes out the head and upper torso. A door sits at the left, a metal bench or rack sits at the right, and the camera remains fixed. The person's hands stay planted flat on the tiles, fingers spread, while hanging plants occupy the upper corner. Within the excerpt, the body lowers from a more extended-arm position toward the floor as the elbows bend. The descent brings the chest and head close to the tiles, leaving the arms bent and the torso held low. After holding this position for a moment, the person begins to rise, extending the arms to lift the torso slightly off the ground. The lower body and feet remain outside the frame, confining the visible action to the upper body and planted hands.
